name: Little Trees
summary: Nottinghamshire pop/rock band representing neurodivergent and disabled communities, with songs that come from the heart.
image_alt: The four members of Little Trees in black and white, standing against a tall brick wall in a narrow alley. Shimara, at the front, is looking up at the sky; the other three look towards the camera.
